segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are divided: a few report severe reactions, including a burning rash needing steroids and chemical burns in an adult who had tolerated the product as a teenager, while many more report it works well without excess redness or dryness, especially when introduced gradually and paired with a moisturizer.
segments.oily: Reviewers with an oily T-zone or oily, acne-prone skin report gradual but real improvement in breakouts and texture over about eight weeks of consistent use.
segments.dry: One reviewer with already dry skin reports the treatment cleared her acne without drying her skin out further.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin reports small breakouts and bumpy patches calm down within a few hours of applying the gel, with no resulting redness or texture.

concerns.blemishes: The great majority of reviewers report fewer and less frequent breakouts, faster healing of individual pimples, and clearer skin after a few weeks of consistent nightly use, with several noting it works on both active breakouts and preventing new ones. A minority report the opposite even after a month or more of use: their acne got worse, stayed the same, or improved only moderately, and a couple note it does not prevent deeper, painful blind pimples even though smaller blemishes shrink.
concerns.dehydration: Dryness and light peeling in the first one to three weeks is widely reported and generally described as manageable, even expected, when paired with a moisturizer, after which several say the dryness resolves as skin adjusts. Some reviewers, including one with already dry skin, report no dryness at all, while a couple say it continues to dry their skin out somewhat throughout use.
concerns.redness: One reviewer developed a severe burning, itching rash needing oral and topical steroids, and warns to stop at the first sign of burning or redness. Far more commonly, reviewers describe only mild, temporary redness in the first week or two that fades on its own, and many long-term users report the product actually reduces pre-existing redness and inflammation over time.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes the gel severely compromising her skin barrier, resulting in a burning, itching rash across her face that required steroid treatment. Other reviewers who introduced the product gradually and moisturized report no such damage, with one describing the formula as protecting the skin barrier while still clearing pores.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report the gel fading dark marks and scarring left by past acne alongside clearing active breakouts. One notes that while breakouts and redness improved, some marks from older acne remained visible.
